README: AI WORKFLOW INSTRUCTIONS - MANDATORY DEPLOYMENT PROCEDURE
CRITICAL_RULE_1: NEVER push multiple commits rapidly - causes staging crashes
CRITICAL_RULE_2: ALWAYS test locally BEFORE any git push
CRITICAL_RULE_3: Git push triggers automatic staging deployment (3-5 min)
CRITICAL_RULE_4: Production ONLY via manual GitHub Actions approval

step1.test: Run task: 🧪 LOCALHOST TEST: Check All APIs

step2.action: Commit changes (ONE commit at a time)
step2.note: Version auto-updates in VERSION.md and version.json

step3.warning: ⚠️ ONLY push ONCE - multiple pushes crash staging

step6.method: GitHub Actions → Three-Stage Deployment → Run workflow → Select production → Approve

VERSION_SYSTEM.display: Version shows in UI 'i' button with commit message

COMMON_MISTAKES_TO_AVOID.mistake1: ❌ Pushing multiple commits rapidly → CAUSES STAGING CRASH
COMMON_MISTAKES_TO_AVOID.mistake2: ❌ Not testing localhost first → Breaks staging
COMMON_MISTAKES_TO_AVOID.mistake3: ❌ Deploying directly to production → BLOCKED by workflow
COMMON_MISTAKES_TO_AVOID.mistake4: ❌ Creating documentation files → NEW AI WON'T READ

DEVELOPMENT_MODE.auto_update_localhost: ✅ ENABLED - Localhost auto-updates after every commit

git_hooks.post-commit: .husky/post-commit runs after git commit to auto-update localhost
git_hooks.behavior: Frontend rebuilds and deploys to localhost Docker containers automatically

manual_rebuild.quick: Press Ctrl+Shift+B (runs task: ⚡ QUICK: Rebuild Localhost After Changes)
manual_rebuild.full: Run task: 🔄 LOCALHOST REBUILD: Fresh Docker Build

watch_script.purpose: Optional background watcher for live development
watch_script.usage: Run task: 🔄 AUTO-RELOAD: Watch Localhost Changes

workflow: 1. Make changes to code (auto-saves after 1 second)
2. Test changes by manually refreshing http://localhost
4. 🔄 POST-COMMIT HOOK AUTO-RUNS: Rebuilds frontend + updates localhost
5. Localhost now has your committed changes
6. Push to staging ONLY when localhost tested and working

MCP_SERVERS.description: Use MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for Docker and Git operations

git_operations.branch_create: mcp_gitkraken_git_branch (directory: path, action: create, branch_name: xxx)
git_operations.commit: mcp_gitkraken_git_add_or_commit (directory: path, action: commit, message: xxx)

pr_and_issues.add_comment: mcp_gitkraken_issues_add_comment (provider: github, issue_id: xxx, comment: xxx)

ai_instructions: ✅ ALWAYS use MCP tools for Docker container operations instead of terminal commands
✅ Use mcp_copilot_conta_list_containers to see running containers
✅ Use mcp_copilot_conta_logs_for_container to check container logs
✅ Use mcp_gitkraken_git_status instead of 'git status' in terminal
❌ AVOID running docker commands in terminal when MCP tool is available
